_comment: Row 310 / F55. The runtime secret-display gate must derive every eligible live GET rule, concretize non-site and multi-argument rules, reconcile every shard receipt and every route execution exactly, and remain scheduled in CI. M1-M5 are assertion-level regressions. The separate transform-control spec applies M1 unchanged to the import-only node and must ESCAPE.
subject: the secret-display census covers the complete runtime-route denominator and treats unavailable execution as UNKNOWN

mutants.label: M1 omit every eligible multi-argument runtime route
mutants.old:
for rule in rules:
        values = dict(rule.defaults or {})
mutants.new:
for rule in (rule for rule in rules if len(rule.arguments) <= 1):
        values = dict(rule.defaults or {})

mutants.label: M2 make non-site Unicode and path arguments unavailable
M3 accept any nonempty subset of expected shard receipts
mutants.old:
assert len(results) == expected_shards, (
        "runtime route scan UNKNOWN: "
        f"expected_shards={expected_shards} collected_shards={len(results)}"
    )
mutants.new:
assert results, (
        "runtime route scan UNKNOWN: "
        f"expected_shards={expected_shards} collected_shards={len(results)}"
    )

mutants.label: M4 accept a nonzero partial execution count
mutants.old:
scanned = sum(result[0] for result in results)
    assert scanned == len(targets) > 0, (
        "runtime route execution denominator mismatch: "
        f"collected={len(targets)} executed={scanned}; verdict is UNKNOWN"
    )
mutants.new:
scanned = sum(result[0] for result in results)
    assert scanned > 0, (
        "runtime route execution denominator mismatch: "
        f"collected={len(targets)} executed={scanned}; verdict is UNKNOWN"
    )

mutants.label: M5 remove the runtime secret census from its CI shard
